title: Terminal: Important Systems
summary: Read the Terminal signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Tabs, navigation pages, recipe views, reward tiers, mission pages, and linked records define the player-facing console surface.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch tabs, record lists, mission state, recipe pages, reward inboxes, archive records, and whether a missing tab belongs to an unloaded addon.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Terminal system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
